requirement: Nitaqat component of the Compliance Risk Screen
finding: server.js constructs createComplianceRiskService WITHOUT nitaqatStore, commented 'omitted until S36-G3 merges'. S36-G3 HAS merged. But the only Nitaqat store in the repo (InMemoryNitaqatStore) is keyed by candidateId and exposes save/get/all — it has NO getZone(tenantId), which is the interface compliance_risk_service requires. Wiring the existing store would NOT satisfy it. The Nitaqat component therefore returns insufficient_data for every tenant and drags the weighted overall score down.
note: Not remediated: no tenant-zone source exists; building one is new scope, and §19 forbids inventing product behaviour.
